resale_co.name: Land Use Compliance Certificate for a property sale (Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Longport Building and Zoning Department
requirements: Inspection by the Building Department before the certificate is issued
Dwelling must comply with federal, state and local housing codes and be kept safe and sanitary with proper light and ventilation (Borough Chapters 108, 110 and 136)
Open permit review by the office (copy to the Tax Assessor)
Submit a current site survey, a flood elevation certificate, the sales contract or proof of sale price, and Form 1A (smoke detector certificate application) with the application

fees.label: Land Use Compliance application for a sale

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the 'Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale' (Housing section of the Borough forms page) with the settlement date, a point of contact and access details (door code, lock box or key), and submit it with the $150.00 fee, a current site survey, a flood elevation certificate, the sales contract or proof of sale price, and Form 1A for the smoke detector certificate to the Building and Zoning Department, 2305 Atlantic Avenue, Longport, NJ 08403. The Building Department inspects and then issues the certificate.

evidence.quote: Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale
A Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate will be issued following an inspection by the Building Department.
Required documents to be submitted with this application Ordinance §70-2

resale_co.notes: The Borough's sale packet (June 2026) is titled 'Application for Land Use Compliance of a Property for Sale' and cites Ordinance §70-2; the Building Department inspects and issues a Certificate of Occupancy and/or Land Use Compliance Certificate. Search results for the Borough code (ecode360 LO0700) show Chapter 70 'Certificates of Land Use Compliance' with § 70-2 'Certificate required', but the code text could not be opened. The form gives no lead time or validity period. No named construction or zoning official is listed on the Borough website (forms and directory checked); office numbers are ext. 108, 109 and 120 (Zoning/Flood ext. 120, zoning@longport-nj.us). The $75.00 smoke detector certificate fee in the same packet is listed under the fire certificate. A separate Rental Application exists for rentals.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level, in every bedroom, and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of doorways
Since January 1, 2019: 10-year sealed lithium battery single-station smoke alarms (ANSI/UL 217); existing AC-powered alarms are accepted and must not be removed
Carbon monoxide alarms on each level and in the immediate vicinity of all sleeping areas
Central-station monitored alarm systems must be inspected by a NJ certified fire protection contractor, with the report available at the fire inspection
Owner, agent or designee must be present; detectors mounted more than 9 feet up must be tested by the owner or agent
A penalty of up to $500.00 may apply if the sale closes before the certificate is received

authorities.name: Longport Bureau of Fire Prevention

fees.label: Certificate of Smoke Detector Compliance application

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete Form 1A (Application for Certificate of Smoke Detector Compliance) in the Borough sale packet and submit it with the Land Use Compliance application. The Longport Fire Official inspects by appointment only. Pay by check only, payable to Longport Bureau of Fire Prevention; no certificate is issued before the fee is paid.

evidence.quote: Form “1A” to be completed in addition to the Land Use Compliance Form.
Inspection conducted by the Longport Fire Official.
Additional Fee: $75.00 Payable to: Longport Bureau of Fire Prevention
No Certificate of Compliance will be issued without the prior payment of the required fee.
LEAID: 0115-001 Longport Boro SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Constr Code Housing Dept

fire_cert.notes: DCA registry code M. Fees and rules come from the Borough's June 2026 sale packet (Form 1A and the smoke detector requirements page). The packet's requirements page does not list a fire extinguisher. The state fire directory (survey 6/25/2026) names Levon S Clayton as Fire Official (firechief@longport-nj.us, (609) 822-9578) and lists 'Constr Code Housing Dept' at 2305 Atlantic Av, (609) 822-0569, for smoke detector compliance. The Borough site lists the Volunteer Fire Department at (609) 822-9578 without names.
